printerCameras.removeDetail: The camera stops showing on this printer. A push camera that still sends pictures is refused.
printerCameras.form.note: A camera sends its own pictures to this server, or this server fetches them from the camera. Add a stream address to watch it with the play button.
printerCameras.form.name: Name
printerCameras.form.nameNote: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It is part of the upload address and cannot be changed later.
printerCameras.form.badName: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, and start and end with a letter or digit.
printerCameras.form.takenName: A camera already has this name.
printerCameras.form.missingUrl: Enter a snapshot address or a stream address.
printerCameras.form.snapshotUrlNote: Leave it empty for a camera that sends its own pictures to this server.
printerCameras.form.streamUrlNote: An rtsp:// address of an H.264 stream, or an http:// address of an MJPEG stream. Leave it empty for a camera that only takes pictures.
